description.en: Adds a re-trigger delay to an NPC encounter, so the same encounter can't immediately be triggered again right after finishing (e.g. right after winning/losing its challenge).
Index of the encounter, from CMND_GET_ENCCHR_INDEX.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Prevent this encounter from immediately re-triggering
CMND_ADD_ENCCHR_DERAY(encIndex);
